EC1: Allergy [OR] or contraindication to paracetamol [OR], Prasugrel [OR] or Ticagrelor
EC2: Paracetamol ingestion in the previous 48 hours
EC3: Patient treated with drugs supposed to alter gastric emptying times (calcium antagonists [OR], Alimentary tract treatments [OR], opioid analgesics [OR], tricyclic antidepressants [OR], antibiotics).
EC4: Conditions [OR] or pathologies supposed to alter gastric emptying times (Thyroid dysfunction [OR], chronic renal failure [OR], Parkinson's disease [OR], scleroderma [OR], amyloidosis [OR], any gastrointestinal disease [OR], any not cured malignancy [OR], and any advanced psychiatric [OR] or neurological disease).
EC6: Cardiogenic shock [OR], ventricular arrhythmia [OR] or resuscitated cardiac arrest
